wire.slash.hub.role: command description line in /help and the completion picker
wire.slash.hub.note: Opens Hub links: per-link subscribe and auto-push policy. No ICU arguments; no placeholders. The key lands ahead of the /hub registry entry; non-en locales carry this en text until the delta translation.

wire.slash.temporary.role: slash command description in a picker list
wire.slash.temporary.note: A temporary chat is left out of history and deleted after it sits idle. 'on, off, status' are the command's literal arguments; keep them verbatim.
